macos.rationale: macOS 11 or later (Apple silicon and Intel) is the stable packaged desktop. Linux x86_64 AppImage and Windows x64 installer are published with v0.3.0 and labelled Experimental. The README Windows wording is superseded; docs add that a release can publish without the Windows build. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI, Mobile client source; native iPhone app in private beta, no public release.

web-client.rationale: Browser web client served by the Podium server (local or VPS). Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI, Mobile client source; native iPhone app in private beta, no public release.

mobile-web.rationale: The download page presents a phone browser path on iPhone or Android with Add to Home Screen, reached over Tailscale or an HTTPS address and paired with a QR code. Docs separately call the /mobile web build an unsupported compatibility path. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI, Mobile client source; native iPhone app in private beta, no public release.

review.note: Send back: the download page presents a phone-browser path, but the cited docs call the /mobile web build an unsupported compatibility path. The receipts disagree, so a phone-browser yes is not established.

ios.rationale: The website describes the native iPhone app as a private beta, and docs say native iPhone distribution is not confirmed; no public App Store or public TestFlight listing is offered. Mapped no under the rule for private or invitation-only betas, as for other products' unreleased platforms. Phone browser access is a separate option.

android.rationale: The complete public client offering lists browser access on Android and an iPhone private beta, but no native Android app.

cli.rationale: podium CLI is part of every install with documented command groups. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI, Mobile client source; native iPhone app in private beta, no public release.

claude-code.rationale: Podium launches the native Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi CLIs in persistent terminals on machines you control. The 0.2.0 release calls Pi fully supported. Models come from each harness catalog, and capabilities differ per harness: Pi declares no quota, handoff or hooks. Mixed-harness operation was not exercised. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

gemini-cli.rationale: The released fixed native harness registry contains Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi, and omits this harness. A generic shell session is not a supported coding-agent adapter.

aider.rationale: The released fixed native harness registry contains Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi, and omits this harness. A generic shell session is not a supported coding-agent adapter.

antigravity.rationale: The released fixed native harness registry contains Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor and Pi, and omits this harness. A generic shell session is not a supported coding-agent adapter.

byo-subscription.rationale: Native Claude subscription and local ChatGPT/Codex login use provider plan capacity. Managed Claude setup-token is also offered. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

local.rationale: The macOS desktop app runs server, daemon and web UI locally. Experimental Linux and Windows desktop builds offer the same local choice. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

own-server.rationale: User-owned Linux host via the headless installer or machine pairing. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The complete public host offering is the user computer or user VPS. A vendor-operated execution service is not offered in that list.

worktree.rationale: Issue-backed work uses a linked worktree; Podium can recreate a hibernated session worktree from its branch. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

container.rationale: The released daemon launches native host processes through PTYs and provides no container provisioning. Worktrees are a separate filesystem mechanism.

vm.rationale: The released daemon launches native host processes through PTYs and provides no vm provisioning. Worktrees are a separate filesystem mechanism.

parallel-runs.rationale: Each session is its own harness process in a pseudo-terminal; one issue can retain several sessions. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

coordinator.rationale: Podium orchestrates delegation itself: podium agent spawn starts a full child session on an issue with a chosen harness, model, effort or agent profile, mail carries messages, and bounded await reports the child result. Children are real sessions shown as seats on the flight deck. Agent-initiated spawns take a daily budget per issue. A complete delegated task with retained child findings was not run. Scope: Podium CLI, Browser client and self-hosted server.

issue-tracking.rationale: Podium exposes native issue creation with an optional start flag, separate dispatch, editing, comments, labels, assignment, search, board filters, archive, sibling ordering and an issue tree. Issue records have their own identity separate from sessions and stages are durable. The idea-to-mission scenario was not run. v0.3.0 refuses an agent close or done update while issue sessions are computing unless --confirm-interrupt is supplied; guidance says to request review and close only on user instruction. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Automations support cron and once schedules; feature flagged and default off in the UI. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

review.note: Send back: the scheduler exists in source, but automations sit behind an edge-visibility feature flag that defaults off and is listed only on the edge channel; docs list automations as non-baseline. That does not establish a supported trigger capability.

roles.rationale: Instance members are member or admin; member routes require admin. Hosted organization roles are not confirmed in production. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

review.note: Send back: member and admin rest on source route checks and a members UI; no documented role permissions were cited, and hosted organization roles are unconfirmed. The facet requires documented permissions.

pr-workflow.rationale: issue action pr runs gh pr create --base <parent> --head <branch> --fill and records the printed URL on the issue; mergeStyle can be pr; requires the GitHub CLI. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

license.rationale: Apache License 2.0 for repository source. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI, Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental).

self-hosting.rationale: Self-hosted headless server and local desktop are documented. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: podium telemetry on/off/show/reset-id, Settings Privacy, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and PODIUM_TELEMETRY=off. Scope: Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

free-tier.rationale: The software is Apache-2.0 and the site marks it free to access; no paid tier is listed. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

starting-price.rationale: The software is Apache-2.0 and the site marks it free to access; no paid tier is listed. Scope: Desktop client (macOS stable; Linux AppImage and Windows installer experimental), Browser client and self-hosted server, Podium CLI.

laptop-independent.rationale: Podium's server and daemon can run headless on a user-owned Linux host (installer or machine pairing), and docs say disconnecting a client does not end the session, so work on that host continues when the controlling laptop sleeps or disconnects. Not tested. Scope: self-hosted server and paired Linux machines, Desktop, Browser and CLI clients.

review-ui.rationale: The product review workflow displays changed files and Git diffs. The Git panel is experimental and default off but can be enabled; no guided-review quality claim is implied.

no-paid-plan.rationale: No published price, billing listed as not implemented, Apache-2.0 source.

byok.rationale: Managed Anthropic and OpenAI API keys.

free-plan.rationale: The public ADE is a free open-source download and billing/hosted metering are explicitly not implemented. Model subscriptions, API charges and own machines are paid separately.
